definition: Identification of the interaction between trading partners to achieve a given business objective.

Default value "ALL" if no restrictions apply.

name: System capabilities context identifier
definition: Identification of major restrictions derived from system, a class of systems or standard in the business situation. Identify the type of system.
code_list:
